comparison.objective: Take an ear temperature by seating a covered probe, pressing Measure, holding through the reading, then laying it down.
comparison.physical_skill: Anatomically constrained insertion-depth control, button actuation, and very stable probe holding.
comparison.success_condition: Proper seating, successful three-second reading within motion limits, safe depth, then released stable placement; deep insertion or dropping permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Although both require narrow-tool alignment in a recessed opening, this record tests gentle insertion and sustained stillness with a safety depth bound. It has no impact, fracture, retained threaded component, or debris recovery.
